name: pir2-academy-sheets-reader
description: Read-only local MCP for PiR2 Academy Sheets Reader

scripts.typecheck:contracts: tsc --noEmit --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --strict --verbatimModuleSyntax --skipLibCheck tests/unit/contracts.test.ts tests/unit/logging.test.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.smoke: node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['server/index.js'], { encoding: 'utf8' }); if (result.status !== 0 || result.stdout !== '') { process.exit(1); }"
